business_problem: For ComplyAdvantage , a financial crime prevention platform, this transformation presented an opportunity to scale its AI-driven services to get ahead of increasing and evolving threats.
solution_summary: ComplyAdvantage's developers now use Gemini Code Assist across multiple critical workflows. For brownfield code navigation, new developers and contractors use Code Assist to understand complex existing codebases, dependencies, and integration points. Instead of relying solely on senior developer availability and lengthy code reviews, team members can quickly grasp context through AI-powered code summaries and explanations. This proves especially valuable for remote contractors who lack the informal knowledge transfer that happens in hybrid office environments. These community meetings also drove adoption of emerging capabilities. When Gemini Code Assist launched command-line interface (CLI) support, senior and principal developers who preferred working in the terminal quickly migrated from alternative tools.
